name: manual_4a39a3
claim: Use the tdd-skip: <reason> commit-message trailer, not --no-verify, when a commit genuinely has nothing for the TDD pairing gate to check

decisions.notes: check_tdd_commit.sh has a documented, narrow, honest opt-out (grep for tdd-skip: trailer -> exit 0) distinct from bypassing an actually-relevant check. Used to unblock a memory-only JSONL/Markdown amend on PT PR #354 that had zero web/src/* files staged.
